items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Ambrose made him a banjo, he had a banjo made out of one of them cheese box.

ctx.x: He played trombone and one played banjo. Ambrose made him a banjo, he had a banjo made out of one of them cheese box. He'd make his banjo. Who did he play with? Well he was playing with Johnny Predos and them. Wooden Joe. Well they just would move around.
But he would play that funny little banjo, that homemade banjo on a real band? Yeah, on a real band.
